HSTU native attention third-party notices

The native attention provider compiles portions of the following projects.
The TensorRT-Model-Connect Apache-2.0 license applies to its original host
adapters and does not replace these third-party licenses. Source headers,
trained weights, CUDA, TensorRT and cuBLAS runtime libraries are not bundled
by this notice payload.

FBGEMM and its HSTU implementation
https://github.com/pytorch/FBGEMM/tree/43791a0ade113a0ad5530c2a4948870dd0f7e417
Copyright (c) 2023, Tri Dao.
Copyright (c) 2024, NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES.
Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.
All rights reserved.
The kernel headers are used without modification. The native host adapter
supplies parameters and launches the existing kernel. FBGEMM.LICENSE.txt and
HSTU.LICENSE.txt below reproduce the upstream license files. The upstream
HSTU license mentions AUTHORS; that revision does not contain an AUTHORS file.
The individual source-header credits are preserved above.

CUTLASS C++ headers
https://github.com/jwfromm/cutlass/tree/571edeb2d0ac872a8392fc49285b156b07884b4e
Copyright (c) 2017 - 2025 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
CUTLASS.LICENSE.txt below reproduces the upstream license. This provider uses
C++ headers; it does not distribute the separately licensed Python CuTeDSL.

CUDA Core Compute Libraries (CCCL): CUB, Thrust and libcu++
https://github.com/NVIDIA/cccl/blob/v3.3.3/LICENSE
Copyright (c) 2011, Duane Merrill. All rights reserved.
Copyright (c) 2011-2024, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
Copyright (c) 2023 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES.
CCCL headers are supplied by the installed CUDA development toolkit. The
CCCL.LICENSE.txt copy below includes CUB's BSD conditions, the Thrust terms,
and the libcu++ Apache-2.0 license with LLVM exceptions and legacy notices.
